_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.1 is off, 0.30 and lower I do not recomm: 1 is off, 0.30 and lower I do not recommend, can mess up physics, and mods like HDT-SMP
Clears pages 2 and up. Page 1 is kept.
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.Click, then press the new controller but: Click, then press the new controller button.
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.Click, then press the new keyboard or mo: Click, then press the new keyboard or mouse button.
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.Could not write the settings file - see: Could not write the settings file - see OrbitMenu.log.
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.Hover over an item in the Inventory menu: Hover over an item in the Inventory menu or a spell in the Magic menu, then press a slot key to assign it.
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.Inventory Interface Information Injector: Inventory Interface Information Injector not installed!
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.Letting go of the Orbit Menu key will eq:
Letting go of the Orbit Menu key will equip last highlighted slot.
It's off by default because just by opening the menu to look could accidentally equip or use something.
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.Mouse DPI, also known as deadzone, is ho:
Mouse DPI, also known as deadzone, is how far the mouse has to move from the middle before the first slot is highlighted.
It protects a small bump when you press the key doesn't highlight anything.
Works like mouse DPI - the lower it is, the more you have to move the mouse, so slots are less likely to be highlighted by accident.
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.No key is bound, so Orbit Menu can not b: No key is bound, so Orbit Menu can not be opened.
Press a keyboard or mouse button...
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.Show Slot Keys if controller detected: Show Slot Keys if controller detected
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.The lower it is, the more you have to mo: The lower it is, the more you have to move the mouse sideways to swing over to the next slot.
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.Title: Title
json:menu_translation/orbit-menu-ng:SKSE.{} can't go on the Orbit Menu: {} can't go on the Orbit Menu
